written_before: any location-phase or priority-2/3/4 run; after two priority-1 calls (mobilenet_v2-int8 wide and control, 0-1000) failed with the transient `bridge v2 kernel error 2` (CUDA allocation failure under contention: 6-11 GB of the 12 GB GPU used by other lanes) at about image 680 and 136; both are being retried as single 1k calls

deviations.what: calls per 1k run (runner mechanics; no rule of the protocol changes)
deviations.rule: From now on a 1k run is made of up to three contiguous predict calls with boundaries 128, 564 and 1000 (tile_stop in tools/run/accumulator_sweep_mn_run.py), assembled by the protocol's reuse rule (the engine is exact and batch invariant; step 1 checked a 64-image file against a 32-image one). Reason: a transient allocation failure loses the whole call; a tile limits the loss to at most 436 images. Cost: about 35 s setup per extra call. The first 128-image tile is also the location tile.
A (case, policy) is launched again after a failed call until it has failed 5 times in one runner process (was: 3 times per call range); failures are reported.
Lane calls are identified from the runner ledger and from the per-run log file names (logs/<case>/<policy>-<start>-<stop>.log), so that calls of a stopped runner are counted.
